topic: Before and after: enquiries scattered everywhere vs. in one place

assets.prompt: Directly overhead photograph of a dark matte desk surface with a small chaotic scatter of blank crumpled paper notes, a blank torn receipt, loose blank sticky notes and a pen lying at an angle, a phone lying face-down, all in the lower half of the frame. One small brass paperclip is the only warm accent. No writing on any paper. The upper 45% of the frame is empty dark desk. Soft single light from the upper left, fine grain.

Directly overhead photograph of the same dark matte desk surface, same camera angle and same soft light from the upper left. A slim matte black tray holds a neat row of five upright blank cream index cards in the lower half of the frame, a pen lying perfectly straight beside it. One small brass paperclip on the first card is the only warm accent. No writing on any card. The upper 45% of the frame is empty dark desk, fine grain.

slides.title: Before
slides.lead: Notes, texts and half-remembered calls. Leads go quiet because nobody knows who is next.

slides.title: After
slides.lead: Every enquiry on one card: who they are, where they came from, what happens next.

slides.title: What changed
slides.lead: One place to look. A next step on every lead. Nothing falls through.

slides.headline: Which one is your business today?

caption:
Before: notes, texts and half-remembered calls.
After: every enquiry in one place, with a next step.

Which one is your business today?

Message us to begin.
